scope: SM-1 and SM-2 target interpretation for the Conversations Boilerplate Reduction initiative.

sm1.name: Conversations classified-plumbing LOC reduction
sm1.interpretation: The frozen Story 1.4 accepted classified-plumbing baseline is the denominator and is not re-estimated after implementation. Equality meets the target.

sm2.name: Minimal-module hand-authored file reduction
sm2.interpretation: The inclusive file-count threshold is met exactly. LOC reduction is mandatory supporting evidence, not a second numeric pass/fail threshold because the PRD pre-specified only a file-count target.
limitations: The template-minimal value is an accepted manifest baseline, not a committed throwaway-module build.
The pre-initiative equivalent is a low-confidence estimate because no accepted artifact reconstructs an exact buildable pre-template minimal skeleton.
The result must remain labeled met-on-accepted-estimate and must not be presented as unconditional or high-confidence proof.

preservationRules: The historical evidence bindings remain byte-identical; their unconfirmed wording is a point-in-time statement.
This decision is the current authority for OQ-2 target interpretation and prospectively supersedes the unresolved interpretation without rewriting the earlier release decision.
The earlier signed release-owner decision remains historically valid for the evidence hashes and conditions it approved at signing time.
nonClaims: This decision does not re-sign, replace, or expand the earlier release-owner attestation.
This decision does not claim high-confidence or build-reconstructed SM-2 comparison evidence.
This decision does not approve inherited platform controls, security certifications, penetration testing, key management, external audit, or platform compliance.
